hero.subtitulo: We connect families with specialized babysitters to provide safe, warm and personalized care.
hero.nota: No commitment. We'll reply on WhatsApp

quienesSomos.intro: We are Delfina and Federica, babysitters with more than six years of experience. For more than three years we have been helping families in Montevideo, Canelones and Punta del Este find trained, responsible and trustworthy babysitters.
quienesSomos.resto: After working with many families, we realized how important it is to have someone truly reliable to look after the children. That is how Parents’ Break was born: so families can enjoy their time knowing their children are in the best hands. Today we have a network of more than 80 sitters, carefully selected by our team. Our commitment is to offer much more than a babysitter: we offer trust, safety and peace of mind to every family.
quienesSomos.fotoAlt: Parents’ Break babysitter playing with children
quienesSomos.subtitulo: We're not an app. We're people.
quienesSomos.cuerpo: Behind every service there is a real team guiding the process. We listen to each family's needs, look for the most suitable babysitter and coordinate every detail personally, so the experience is simple, close and reliable. Our selection process is supported by psychologists and professionals specialized in childhood, prioritizing not only experience but also responsibility, warmth and the human quality of each profile. All Parents’ Break babysitters have previous childcare experience and go through interviews, reference checks and assessments before joining the team.

valores.texto: Every babysitter goes through a rigorous selection process supported by psychologists and professionals specialized in childhood, so we choose the best-prepared babysitters for each family. We assess previous experience, hold personal interviews and check references.
We stay with you through every service, from start to finish. We want families to feel safe, comfortable and truly supported.
We only work with babysitters we would recommend to our own families. That is our standard.

servicios.subtitulo: We support families at different moments of everyday life with selected, responsible babysitters prepared for every situation.

tarjetas.descripcion: Babysitters who build a real bond with the kids through play, attention and active involvement.
tarjetas.descripcionResto: We adapt to each family's routine so the children feel comfortable, entertained and cared for at all times.
items: Toys made in Uruguay to encourage play-based development

tarjetas.descripcion: We look after your pet and make sure it feels safe and accompanied when you can't be there.
items: Home visits to feed and walk your pet
Care for your pet and home while you travel (overnight stays)
Boarding for your pet at one of our sitters' homes

tarjetas.descripcion: We create fun, lively spaces so the kids have a great time while the adults can relax.
tarjetas.descripcionResto: We plan activities adapted to the children's ages, the number of kids and the type of event.

nineras.subtitulo: Everyone who joins Parents' Break goes through a selection process designed to guarantee safety, trust and human quality.

proceso.texto: We review previous experience, training, availability and personal profile.
We meet each candidate to assess her vocation, responsibility and fit with our standards.
Psychologists and professionals specialized in childhood support the selection process to ensure reliable profiles suited to childcare.

cualidades.texto: Students and profiles related to Medicine, Early Childhood Education, Psychology and similar fields.
Experience in homes, hotels, events and childcare.
Services 24 hours a day, 7 days a week
Experience with babies, children and/or teenagers.
